headline: Corn futures drop 1% toward 12-month low while soybean prices tick upward
summary: Corn futures fell 1.00% to near a one-year low under steady selling pressure and large Brazilian harvest projections. Soybeans gained slightly while wheat prices weakened.
why: Grain commodity benchmarks set global feed and food costs. Production output in South America directly impacts international grain trade pricing.

impacts.name: Corn Futures
impacts.why: Prices fell 1.00% close to a 12-month low due to strong Brazilian harvest supply.
